description: EAGLE-I Power Outage Data Information is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Varisara Tansakul, Aaron Myers. This DOI contains information on the EAGLE-I power outage dataset and serves as a blanket DOI for all EAGLE-I historic data. Historic power outage data from specific years have been linked to this DOI. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
